response.justification: The candidate is an experienced full-stack web developer with strong TypeScript/Node.js and some low-level DLang and C/C++ background, but he does not meet the core requirements of this role: there is no evidence of native-level Japanese proficiency (a hard requirement), no Linux kernel investigation or source modification experience, no embedded firmware or LAN-switch product work, and no exposure to the required security technologies (MACsec, 802.1X, MAC authentication) or networking protocols (SNMP, NETCONF, L2/L3 switching). His C experience is limited to a brief stint at National Instruments a decade ago.
strengths: Deep overall software engineering experience (15+ years) with strong testing and craftsmanship practices
Some systems-level experience with low-latency DLang services and C/C++ IDE components
Comfortable with Linux, CI/CD, and building development environments
concerns: No Japanese language proficiency, which is a mandatory requirement
No embedded networking, LAN-switch, or security-technology experience (MACsec, 802.1X, SNMP, NETCONF)
No demonstrated Linux kernel analysis or modification experience; C for UNIX experience is minimal and dated

key_factors.factor: Strong general engineering and systems background
